diagnosis_text:

 root_cause: The mem-load sidecar in Deployment/vigil-app is declared in git to run stress-ng with --vm-bytes 50M while its own container memory limit is only 32Mi, so the in-container allocation always exceeds the cgroup limit and the kernel kills the process, producing repeated OOMKilled restarts. root_cause_component: Deployment/vigil-app:mem-load
